cl:changeset.author: arcus
cl:changeset.cl:description: Create api_key table partitioned by placeId for listing keys per place

cl:cql.cl:update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS api_key ( placeId uuid, id uuid, label varchar, keyPrefix varchar, keyHash varchar, personId uuid, accountId uuid, permissions set<varchar>, created timestamp, lastUsed timestamp, PRIMARY KEY (placeId, id) )

cl:changeset.author: arcus
cl:changeset.cl:description: Create api_key_by_hash table for authentication lookup by key hash

cl:cql.cl:update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS api_key_by_hash ( keyHash varchar, id uuid, placeId uuid, label varchar, keyPrefix varchar, personId uuid, accountId uuid, permissions set<varchar>, created timestamp, lastUsed timestamp, PRIMARY KEY (keyHash) )

cl:changeset.author: arcus
cl:changeset.cl:description: Create api_key_by_id table for looking up key label by id (used by history service)

cl:cql.cl:update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS api_key_by_id ( id uuid, placeId uuid, label varchar, PRIMARY KEY (id) )
